divine_orders.name: Divine Order: Protector
divine_orders.description: Trained for battle, you gain proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Heavy armor.

divine_orders.name: Divine Order: Thaumaturge
divine_orders.description: You know one extra cantrip from the Cleric spell list. In addition, your mystical connection to the divine gives you a bonus to your Intelligence (Arcana or Religion) checks equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of +1).

primal_orders.name: Primal Order: Magician
primal_orders.description: You know one extra cantrip from the Druid spell list. In addition, your mystical connection to nature gives you a bonus to your Intelligence (Arcana or Nature) checks equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of +1).

primal_orders.name: Primal Order: Warden
primal_orders.description: Trained for battle, you gain proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Medium armor.

fighter.name: Fighting Style: Archery
fighter.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with Ranged weapons.

fighter.name: Fighting Style: Blind Fighting
fighter.description: You have Blindsight with a range of 10 feet.

fighter.name: Fighting Style: Defense
fighter.description: While you're wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor, you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class.

fighter.name: Fighting Style: Dueling
fighter.description: When you're holding a Melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

fighter.name: Fighting Style: Great Weapon Fighting
fighter.description: When you roll damage for an attack you make with a Melee weapon that you are holding with two hands, you can treat any 1 or 2 on a damage die as a 3.

fighter.name: Fighting Style: Interception
fighter.description: Reaction when a creature hits an ally within 5 feet: reduce the damage by 1d10 plus your Proficiency Bonus (requires a Shield or a Simple or Martial weapon).

fighter.name: Fighting Style: Protection
fighter.description: Reaction when an attacker makes an attack roll against an ally within 5 feet while you hold a Shield: impose Disadvantage on that roll and subsequent attacks against that ally until the start of your next turn.

fighter.name: Fighting Style: Thrown Weapon Fighting
fighter.description: When you hit with a ranged attack roll using a weapon that has the Thrown property, you gain a +2 bonus to the damage roll.

fighter.name: Fighting Style: Two-Weapon Fighting
fighter.description: When you make an extra attack as a result of using a weapon that has the Light property, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of that attack.

fighter.name: Fighting Style: Unarmed Fighting
fighter.description: Your Unarmed Strike deals 1d6 + STR Bludgeoning damage (1d8 if not holding weapons or a Shield), and at the start of your turn you deal 1d4 Bludgeoning damage to one creature grappled by you.

paladin.name: Fighting Style: Blessed Warrior
paladin.description: You learn two Cleric cantrips of your choice (Charisma spellcasting) and can replace one when you gain a Paladin level.

paladin.name: Fighting Style: Blind Fighting
paladin.description: You have Blindsight with a range of 10 feet.

paladin.name: Fighting Style: Defense
paladin.description: While you're wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor, you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class.

paladin.name: Fighting Style: Dueling
paladin.description: When you're holding a Melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

paladin.name: Fighting Style: Great Weapon Fighting
paladin.description: When you roll damage for an attack you make with a Melee weapon that you are holding with two hands, you can treat any 1 or 2 on a damage die as a 3.

paladin.name: Fighting Style: Interception
paladin.description: Reaction when a creature hits an ally within 5 feet: reduce the damage by 1d10 plus your Proficiency Bonus.

paladin.name: Fighting Style: Protection
paladin.description: Reaction when an attacker targets an ally within 5 feet while you hold a Shield: impose Disadvantage on attacks against that ally until the start of your next turn.

ranger.name: Fighting Style: Archery
ranger.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with Ranged weapons.

ranger.name: Fighting Style: Blind Fighting
ranger.description: You have Blindsight with a range of 10 feet.

ranger.name: Fighting Style: Defense
ranger.description: While you're wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor, you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class.

ranger.name: Fighting Style: Druidic Warrior
ranger.description: You learn two Druid cantrips of your choice (Wisdom spellcasting) and can replace one when you gain a Ranger level.

ranger.name: Fighting Style: Dueling
ranger.description: When you're holding a Melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

ranger.name: Fighting Style: Thrown Weapon Fighting
ranger.description: When you hit with a ranged attack roll using a weapon that has the Thrown property, you gain a +2 bonus to the damage roll.

ranger.name: Fighting Style: Two-Weapon Fighting
ranger.description: When you make an extra attack as a result of using a weapon that has the Light property, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of that attack.

eldritch_invocations.name: Pact of the Blade
eldritch_invocations.description: Bonus Action conjures or bonds a Simple or Martial Melee Pact Weapon you are proficient with; use Charisma for its attack and damage rolls and deal Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant damage.

eldritch_invocations.name: Pact of the Chain
eldritch_invocations.description: Learn Find Familiar and cast it as a Magic action without a slot, choosing special forms (Imp, Pseudodragon, Quasit, Skeleton, Slaad Tadpole, Sphinx of Wonder, Sprite, or Venomous Snake).

eldritch_invocations.name: Pact of the Tome
eldritch_invocations.description: Conjure a Book of Shadows granting three cantrips from any class's spell list and two Level 1 Ritual spells from any class's spell list.

eldritch_invocations.name: Armor of Shadows
eldritch_invocations.description: Cast Mage Armor on yourself without expending a spell slot.

eldritch_invocations.name: Eldritch Mind
eldritch_invocations.description: You have Advantage on Constitution saving throws that you make to maintain Concentration.

eldritch_invocations.name: Lessons of the First Ones
eldritch_invocations.description: Gain an Origin feat of your choice (repeatable for distinct Origin feats).

eldritch_invocations.name: Agonizing Blast
eldritch_invocations.description: Choose one of your known Warlock cantrips that deals damage; add your Charisma modifier to that spell's damage rolls.

eldritch_invocations.name: Devil's Sight
eldritch_invocations.description: See normally in Dim Light and Darkness—both magical and nonmagical—within 120 feet of yourself.

eldritch_invocations.name: Fiendish Vigor
eldritch_invocations.description: Cast False Life on yourself without expending a spell slot, automatically receiving the maximum Temporary Hit Points.

eldritch_invocations.name: Mask of Many Faces
eldritch_invocations.description: Cast Disguise Self without expending a spell slot.

eldritch_invocations.name: Misty Visions
eldritch_invocations.description: Cast Silent Image without expending a spell slot.

eldritch_invocations.name: Otherworldly Leap
eldritch_invocations.description: Cast Jump on yourself without expending a spell slot.

eldritch_invocations.name: Repelling Blast
eldritch_invocations.description: Choose one of your known Warlock cantrips requiring an attack roll; on a hit against a Large or smaller creature, push it up to 10 feet straight away.

eldritch_invocations.name: Eldritch Smite
eldritch_invocations.description: Once per turn when you hit a creature with your pact weapon, expend a Pact Magic slot to deal an extra 1d8 Force damage (+1d8 per slot level) and knock a Huge or smaller target Prone.

eldritch_invocations.name: Gaze of Two Minds
eldritch_invocations.description: Bonus Action perceives through a willing creature's senses and lets you cast spells as if you were in its space.

eldritch_invocations.name: Gift of the Depths
eldritch_invocations.description: Breathe underwater, gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed, and cast Water Breathing once per Long Rest without a slot.

eldritch_invocations.name: Investment of the Chain Master
eldritch_invocations.description: Empower your familiar with Fly/Swim Speed 40 ft, Bonus Action attack, Radiant/Necrotic damage, your Spell Save DC, and Reaction Resistance.

eldritch_invocations.name: Master of Myriad Forms
eldritch_invocations.description: Cast Alter Self without expending a spell slot.

eldritch_invocations.name: One with Shadows
eldritch_invocations.description: While in Dim Light or Darkness, cast Invisibility on yourself without expending a spell slot.

eldritch_invocations.name: Thirsting Blade
eldritch_invocations.description: Gain the Extra Attack feature for your pact weapon only: attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action.

eldritch_invocations.name: Whispers of the Grave
eldritch_invocations.description: Cast Speak with Dead without expending a spell slot.

eldritch_invocations.name: Ascendant Step
eldritch_invocations.description: Cast Levitate on yourself without expending a spell slot.

eldritch_invocations.name: Gift of the Protectors
eldritch_invocations.description: Creatures who write their names in your Book of Shadows drop to 1 HP instead of 0 HP once per Long Rest.

eldritch_invocations.name: Lifedrinker
eldritch_invocations.description: Once per turn on a hit with your pact weapon, deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant damage and optionally expend a Hit Point Die to regain HP.

eldritch_invocations.name: Visions of Distant Realms
eldritch_invocations.description: Cast Arcane Eye without expending a spell slot.

eldritch_invocations.name: Devouring Blade
eldritch_invocations.description: The Extra Attack of your Thirsting Blade invocation confers two extra attacks rather than one (three attacks total with your pact weapon).

eldritch_invocations.name: Witch Sight
eldritch_invocations.description: You have Truesight with a range of 30 feet.

metamagic.name: Metamagic: Careful Spell
metamagic.description: Spend 1 Sorcery Point to let up to CHA modifier chosen creatures automatically succeed on their saving throw against your spell and take no damage if it deals half damage on a success.

metamagic.name: Metamagic: Distant Spell
metamagic.description: Spend 1 Sorcery Point to double the range of a spell with a range of at least 5 feet, or change a Touch spell's range to 30 feet.

metamagic.name: Metamagic: Empowered Spell
metamagic.description: Spend 1 Sorcery Point to reroll up to CHA modifier damage dice of a spell (can combine with another Metamagic option).

metamagic.name: Metamagic: Extended Spell
metamagic.description: Spend 1 Sorcery Point to double a spell's duration (up to 24 hours) and gain Advantage on Concentration saves to maintain it.

metamagic.name: Metamagic: Heightened Spell
metamagic.description: Spend 2 Sorcery Points to give one target Disadvantage on all saving throws made against your spell.

metamagic.name: Metamagic: Quickened Spell
metamagic.description: Spend 2 Sorcery Points to change a spell's casting time from 1 Action to 1 Bonus Action (cannot cast another leveled spell this turn).

metamagic.name: Metamagic: Seeking Spell
metamagic.description: Spend 1 Sorcery Point when you miss with a spell attack roll to reroll the d20 (can combine with another Metamagic option).

metamagic.name: Metamagic: Subtle Spell
metamagic.description: Spend 1 Sorcery Point to cast a spell without Verbal, Somatic, or non-consumed/non-costly Material components.

metamagic.name: Metamagic: Transmuted Spell
metamagic.description: Spend 1 Sorcery Point to change a spell's Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder damage type to another type on that list.

metamagic.name: Metamagic: Twinned Spell
metamagic.description: Spend 1 Sorcery Point when casting a spell that can be upcast to target an additional creature to increase its effective spell level by 1 for targeting.

maneuvers.name: Maneuver: Ambush
maneuvers.description: Expend a Superiority Die to add it to a Dexterity (Stealth) check or an Initiative roll.

maneuvers.name: Maneuver: Bait and Switch
maneuvers.description: Swap spaces with a willing creature within 5 feet, adding a Superiority Die to either your or the ally's AC until the start of your next turn.

maneuvers.name: Maneuver: Commander's Strike
maneuvers.description: Forgo one attack during the Attack action to direct a nearby ally to make a Reaction weapon attack adding your Superiority Die to damage.

maneuvers.name: Maneuver: Commanding Presence
maneuvers.description: Expend a Superiority Die to add it to a Charisma (Intimidation, Performance, or Persuasion) check.

maneuvers.name: Maneuver: Disarming Attack
maneuvers.description: Add a Superiority Die to weapon damage and force a STR save or make the target drop one held object.

maneuvers.name: Maneuver: Distracting Strike
maneuvers.description: Add a Superiority Die to weapon damage and grant the next attack roll against the target by another creature Advantage.

maneuvers.name: Maneuver: Evasive Footwork
maneuvers.description: Bonus Action expends a Superiority Die, adding it to your AC until the start of your next turn when taking the Disengage action.

maneuvers.name: Maneuver: Feinting Attack
maneuvers.description: Bonus Action expends a Superiority Die for Advantage on your next attack roll against a creature within 5 feet, adding the die to damage on a hit.

maneuvers.name: Maneuver: Goading Attack
maneuvers.description: Add a Superiority Die to weapon damage and force a WIS save or give the target Disadvantage on attacks against targets other than you.

maneuvers.name: Maneuver: Lunging Attack
maneuvers.description: Bonus Action Dash and expend a Superiority Die to make a melee attack with extra damage.

maneuvers.name: Maneuver: Maneuvering Attack
maneuvers.description: Add a Superiority Die to weapon damage and let an ally use a Reaction to move up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks from your target.

maneuvers.name: Maneuver: Menacing Attack
maneuvers.description: Add a Superiority Die to weapon damage and force a WIS save or Frighten the target until the end of your next turn.

maneuvers.name: Maneuver: Parry
maneuvers.description: Reaction when damaged by a melee attack: expend a Superiority Die to reduce the damage by the roll plus your STR or DEX modifier.

maneuvers.name: Maneuver: Precision Attack
maneuvers.description: Expend a Superiority Die and add it to a weapon attack roll before or after rolling.

maneuvers.name: Maneuver: Pushing Attack
maneuvers.description: Add a Superiority Die to weapon damage and force a Large or smaller target to pass a STR save or be pushed up to 15 feet away.

maneuvers.name: Maneuver: Rally
maneuvers.description: Bonus Action expends a Superiority Die to grant a visible ally Temporary HP equal to the roll plus half your Fighter level.

maneuvers.name: Maneuver: Riposte
maneuvers.description: Reaction when a creature misses you with a melee attack: expend a Superiority Die to make a melee attack adding the die to damage.

maneuvers.name: Maneuver: Sweeping Attack
maneuvers.description: Expend a Superiority Die on a melee hit to deal the die's damage to another creature within 5 feet if your original roll would hit it.

maneuvers.name: Maneuver: Tactical Assessment
maneuvers.description: Expend a Superiority Die to add it to an Intelligence (History or Investigation) or Wisdom (Insight) check.

maneuvers.name: Maneuver: Trip Attack
maneuvers.description: Add a Superiority Die to weapon damage and force a Large or smaller target to pass a STR save or have the Prone condition.

artificer_infusions.name: Plan: Bag of Holding
artificer_infusions.description: Replicate a magical Bag of Holding using Replicate Magic Item.

artificer_infusions.name: Plan: Enhanced Defense (+1 Armor/Shield)
artificer_infusions.description: Replicate +1 Armor or a +1 Shield (upgrading at higher Artificer levels).

artificer_infusions.name: Plan: Enhanced Weapon (+1 Weapon)
artificer_infusions.description: Replicate a +1 Magic Weapon.

artificer_infusions.name: Plan: Wand of the War Mage (+1)
artificer_infusions.description: Replicate a +1 Wand of the War Mage granting +1 to spell attack rolls and ignoring Half Cover.

artificer_infusions.name: Plan: Repeating Shot
artificer_infusions.description: Replicate a +1 magic ranged weapon that ignores Loading and creates its own ammunition.

artificer_infusions.name: Plan: Returning Weapon
artificer_infusions.description: Replicate a +1 magic thrown weapon that flies back to your hand after a ranged attack.

artificer_infusions.name: Plan: Mind Sharpener
artificer_infusions.description: Replicate Mind Sharpener armor/robes with 4 charges to turn a failed Concentration save into a success as a Reaction.

artificer_infusions.name: Plan: Goggles of Night
artificer_infusions.description: Replicate Goggles of Night granting 60 ft Darkvision (+60 ft if already possessed).

artificer_infusions.name: Plan: Alchemy Jug
artificer_infusions.description: Replicate an Alchemy Jug that produces useful mundane liquids daily.

artificer_infusions.name: Plan: Cloak of Protection
artificer_infusions.description: Replicate a Cloak of Protection (+1 AC and +1 to all Saving Throws).

artificer_infusions.name: Plan: Boots of Elvenkind
artificer_infusions.description: Replicate Boots of Elvenkind granting Advantage on Stealth checks to move silently.

artificer_infusions.name: Plan: Radiant Weapon
artificer_infusions.description: Replicate a +1 luminous magic weapon with 4 charges to Blind melee attackers via Reaction.

artificer_infusions.name: Plan: Repulsion Shield
artificer_infusions.description: Replicate a +1 Shield with 4 charges to push melee attackers up to 15 feet via Reaction.

artificer_infusions.name: Plan: Spell-Refueling Ring
artificer_infusions.description: Replicate a ring that recovers one expended spell slot of 3rd level or lower once per dawn.

artificer_infusions.name: Plan: Gauntlets of Ogre Power
artificer_infusions.description: Replicate Gauntlets of Ogre Power setting your Strength score to 19.

artificer_infusions.name: Plan: Headband of Intellect
artificer_infusions.description: Replicate a Headband of Intellect setting your Intelligence score to 19.

artificer_infusions.name: Plan: Winged Boots
artificer_infusions.description: Replicate Winged Boots granting a Fly Speed equal to your Speed.

artificer_infusions.name: Plan: Amulet of Health
artificer_infusions.description: Replicate an Amulet of Health setting your Constitution score to 19.

artificer_infusions.name: Plan: Belt of Hill Giant Strength
artificer_infusions.description: Replicate a Belt of Hill Giant Strength setting your Strength score to 21.

artificer_infusions.name: Plan: Ring of Protection
artificer_infusions.description: Replicate a Ring of Protection (+1 AC and +1 to all Saving Throws).

3.name: Hunter's Prey: Colossus Slayer
3.description: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a weapon, deal an extra 1d8 damage if it is missing any of its Hit Points.

3.name: Hunter's Prey: Horde Breaker
3.description: Once on each of your turns when you make a weapon attack, make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature within 5 feet of the original target.

7.name: Defensive Tactics: Escape the Horde
7.description: Opportunity Attacks have Disadvantage against you.

7.name: Defensive Tactics: Multiattack Defense
7.description: When a creature hits you with an attack roll, that creature has Disadvantage on all other attack rolls against you this turn.

cunning_strikes.name: Cunning Strike: Poison
cunning_strikes.description: Forgo 1d6 Sneak Attack: target makes a CON save or gains the Poisoned condition for 1 minute (requires Poisoner's Kit).

cunning_strikes.name: Cunning Strike: Trip
cunning_strikes.description: Forgo 1d6 Sneak Attack: Large or smaller target makes a DEX save or falls Prone.

cunning_strikes.name: Cunning Strike: Withdraw
cunning_strikes.description: Forgo 1d6 Sneak Attack: move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

cunning_strikes.name: Devious Strike: Daze
cunning_strikes.description: Forgo 2d6 Sneak Attack: target makes a CON save or can only move, take an action, or take a Bonus Action on its next turn.

cunning_strikes.name: Devious Strike: Knock Out
cunning_strikes.description: Forgo 6d6 Sneak Attack: target makes a CON save or falls Unconscious for 1 minute (repeating save each turn or waking on damage).

cunning_strikes.name: Devious Strike: Obscure
cunning_strikes.description: Forgo 3d6 Sneak Attack: target makes a DEX save or is Blinded until the end of its next turn.
